title: Albumin–globulin synergy does not improve cross-cycle CRP prediction beyond conventional protein measures
abstract: Adding (4-albumin)*(globulin-3) to a flexible albumin/globulin-ratio comparator did not improve log-CRP prediction from NHANES 2007-08 to 2009-10: target MSE reduction -0.0007040, two-sample PSU-refit 95% interval [-0.0123963, 0.0034704].
